title: Icons
slide_intent: Teach designers to reduce an idea to a few strokes that can survive a small size. Sorting related icons together makes differences in meaning easier to inspect.
strategic_value: Slack can extend one recognizable drawing style across product, marketing and events while choosing symbols appropriate to each role.
demonstration: Four labeled groups collect outlined icons for Slack.com, roles, events and miscellaneous uses. Each group uses small specimens with consistent visual weight and spacing.
practical_value: Compare a proposed icon with the closest subject group to judge whether its silhouette and detail level fit the surrounding family.

content_islands.name: Purpose statement
content_islands.spec: Use the narrow left column to explain the settings where the icons appear and the job their simple forms perform.

content_islands.name: Website icon family
content_islands.spec: Place the longest group across the top of the specimen field. Align its small outlined icons in two rows.

content_islands.name: Roles and events
content_islands.spec: Place the two labeled grids side by side beneath the website group so their subject matter can be compared.

content_islands.name: Miscellaneous symbols
content_islands.spec: Place the remaining small objects and interface symbols in a final labeled grid below.
